name: Takamine Minori
source:
The third daughter of the Takamine family.
She is a college student who's high spirited and a bit of an otaku.
She hopes to become close friends with the protagonist.
She is a casual hedonist and loves to talk.
Her hobbies cover all subcultures.

"Nyahaha! That's hella dope♪!"
